Name: Vibrant Farmhouse Kitchens
Author: Dracofly1192
Description:
Hi! 

If, like me, you get tired of the same boring brown house Robin builds, you may be ready for a whole new look. 

Introducing the [b]Vibrant Kitchen Collection[/b]! 

After studying the process, I took the leap and created this lovely new kitchen- sporting fresh white on the stairs and cabinets, and a rich, striking blue on the appliances.  The adult bed is also decked in blue and white, while the nursery crib and beds have a happy sunset look with blues, pinks, and yellows.  I really enjoyed making this and plan to do several other colors schemes. All the furniture you see is mine as well and will be uploaded when finished.

EDIT:

Vibrant Harvest Green Kitchen is now available!  Featuring a brand new dark wood look on the cabinets and bed frames, and vines casually hanging out on the door frame.  The adult bed had a lovely green spread speckled with wild flowers, while the crib and toddler beds have been updated to resemble mushrooms!

I have an entire furniture collection to go with this scheme.  You can download it at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4629/]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4629/[/url].  Be on the lookout for other furniture color packs coming soon!

EDIT:

Content Patcher versions now available!



And thanks so much to everyone for the interest in my first foray into modding!  You guys rock!



To Install simple drag and drop the files into Stardew Valley/Content and Stardew Valley/Content/Maps

DON'T FORGET TO BACK UP YOUR FILES!

Enjoy! 

And feel free to leave me a comment or request :)
